description:
Our incoming batch of Stargazers expected in September is sold out. We have opened up an additional limited run of about a dozen frames due in spring 2027. Any Ti Stargazer purchased after August 15th 2026 will be expected in this later batch. All frame details are the same.

Our titanium frame sets use custom multi-butted, cold-formed oversized 3Al-2.5V tubing paired with a chromoly steel fork. The result is a frame that's approximately two pounds lighter than its steel counterpart, with the corrosion resistance and fatigue life that make titanium a true forever material. Same geometry, same rack and fender mounts, same ride-anywhere capability.

We've been riding these frames in production and prototype form for several years now, and it's the bike we find ourselves reaching for more than any other for both loaded touring and swoopy trail riding. If you appreciate the lighter weight, corrosion resistance, and dreamy ride quality that titanium offers, then the titanium version of your favorite Tumbleweed is a great option.

We order titanium frames in occasional, very limited production runs.

Geometry is identical to steel Stargazer (with UDH) signature build with SRAM Rival/Ratio and Eagle GX. As always, complete builds are customizable.

3Al-2.5V multi butted titanium tubing, ovalized top tube and down tube

Frameset includes titanium frame with steel fork, seat clamp, front and rear thru axles

Ti frame saves approximately 2lbs over the steel frame (4.25lb vs 6.25lb for an Extra Medium or 57cm frame)

Brushed bare titanium finish with dark midnight logos and a matching dark midnight steel fork (same fork that comes with the steel frameset)

29x2.6” or 27.5x3.0” tire clearance with machined titanium chainstay yoke

31.6mm seatpost (compatible with internally routed dropper posts)

44mm headtube for ZS44 upper headset cups and EC44 lower cups, 30mm crown race with stock fork

Threaded bosses for full size racks and fenders front and rear, three sets of bottle bosses on main triangle, triple bottle bosses on each fork leg

148x12mm frame spacing and 110x15mm fork spacing

160/180mm flat mount disc brakes front and rear

1x drivetrain specific frame, 38t max chainring with 52mm chainline

Stargazer Limited-Run Titanium Frameset

We offer the Stargazer frameset in titanium with a steel fork in limited runs, generally once a year. This is a high-end frame with multi-butted, cold-formed oversized custom 3Al-2.5V tubing that stands up to loaded off-road riding without turning into a noodle.

We've been riding these frames in production and prototype form for several years now, and it's the bike we find ourselves reaching for more than any other for both loaded touring and swoopy trail riding. If you appreciate the lighter weight, corrosion resistance, and dreamy ride quality that titanium offers, then the titanium version of the Stargazer is a great option. These feature the same geometry and specs as the steel Stargazer Gen 2.

components.description: Unicrown Chromoly steel with 110x15mm thru axle (thru axle included), upper and lower rack mounts, fender mounts, triple bottle cage mounts on fork legs, internal dynamo wire routing, 30mm Crown Race
